summary.text: Larry Klemin is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 47 (home city listed as Bismarck), serving since 1999 per the legislature's member page.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's biography for Klemin lists an occupation of Lawyer, Schweigert, Klemin & McBride, PC.
It lists education as BA, English, UND; JD, UND.
It also lists US Army, Vietnam Veteran, 101st Airborne Division (Air Assault).
Family is listed as: Married (Rita); 2 children.
For the 2025 regular session, the page lists Klemin's standing committee assignments as Judiciary (chairman) and Political Subdivisions.
